name: Anand N S
description: The Convenor leads the Samithi with devotion, humility, and discipline, upholding Baba's teachings. He coordinate all seva, spiritual, and educational activities with unity and love. He act as a bridge between members and higher organizational levels. Maintaining records and encouraging participation in all wings is part of their sacred duty.

name: Venkata Narayana
description: The Service Coordinator plans and organizes all seva activities with dedication and discipline. They ensure regular Narayana Seva, medical camps, environmental efforts, and community outreach. They inspire volunteers to serve with love, humility, and unity. Documentation and reporting of service activities is also their key responsibility.

name: Hari Haran
description: The Youth Coordinator guides Sai youth in spiritual, service, and leadership activities. They inspire young minds to live Baba's message through discipline, seva, and devotion. They organize youth satsangs, service projects, and training sessions. Their focus is to build character, unity, and commitment among the younger generation.

name: Venkata Narayana
description: The IT Coordinator manages all digital and technical needs of the Samithi. They maintain websites, communication platforms, and support online seva initiatives. They help document activities, design media, and streamline event coordination. Bridging technology and seva, they enable efficient and inspired service delivery.

name: Rajeshwari
description: The Spiritual Coordinator leads all devotional activities like bhajans, study circles, and japa sessions. They nurture the spiritual growth of members through regular satsangs and scriptural study. They ensure all programs align with Bhagawan's teachings and calendar. Inspiring inner transformation through collective prayer and devotion is their core mission.
